title: Sprint status tracking
description: The single Phase 7-11 story-tracking artefact: _context/tracking/sprint-status.yaml. Produced by `story-graph` (P7, one story per wave), read + written by `dev-story` (P8 status transitions), and read by `operate-loop`/`readiness`/`retrospective`. Supersedes the retired wave-status-v{N}.md (WS10-B2 unification): one file, unversioned YAML, `ST-*`/`CT-*`/`IN-*` ids matching the story-graph convention.

id.description: Story id — matches the story-graph convention (ST-*, CT-*, IN-*).

status.description: dev-story transitions ready-for-dev → in-progress → review → done. A wave is complete when all its stories are done.
